hotkeys.query: OpenWhispr dictation hotkeys shortcuts hold tap activation mode
hotkeys.text: Use Settings → App → Hotkeys to review your shortcuts. Dictation uses the selected Tap or Hold activation mode; availability depends on your platform and shortcut. Voice Assistant, Translation and Meeting Mode have separate shortcuts.

microphone.query: OpenWhispr choose microphone permissions no audio
microphone.text: Review your input device in Settings → App → Preferences. Check microphone permission under Settings → System → Privacy & Data. A saved microphone choice or granted permission does not prove that recording works; check the input level while speaking.

models.query: OpenWhispr local models speech to text language models configuration
models.text: Speech-to-text turns audio into words; language models handle cleanup and assistant answers. Configure them separately under Settings → AI Models. Dictation, Note Recording and Audio Upload each have their own speech-to-text selection. Download the local models you need before going offline.

meetings.query: OpenWhispr record meeting system audio permission speaker labels
meetings.text: Meeting recordings need microphone audio for your voice and system audio for other participants. Check permissions under Settings → System → Privacy & Data. Choose the recording engine under Settings → AI Models → Speech-to-Text → Note Recording.

calendar.query: OpenWhispr connect calendar Google Microsoft Apple meetings
calendar.text: Open Integrations → Calendars to review calendar connections. Calendar access and meeting audio capture are separate: connecting a calendar does not grant microphone or system audio permission.

language.query: OpenWhispr interface language transcription language translation
language.text: Interface language and Transcription language are separate settings under Settings → App → Preferences. Transcription language applies across recording activities. Translation is a separate feature with its own shortcut and target language.

backup.query: OpenWhispr cloud backup sync notes devices local storage
backup.text: Cloud backup controls syncing notes across devices. It is separate from the model used for transcription or assistant answers. Your organisation may restrict backup or processing choices.

assistant.query: OpenWhispr chat agent tools model availability voice assistant
assistant.text: The assistant answers questions using its selected language model. Tool availability depends on the model, connections and organisation policy. Small or unrecognised local models run without tools. This Help view works without an AI model, including offline essentials.
